cohort: 210 pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 who reported to Gandhi Medical College, Bhopal, between April 2020 and May 2021.
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had an increased risk of maternal complications and caesarean section compared to pregnant women without COVID-19, with the second wave (January 2021-May 2021) resulting in significantly more maternal deaths (22) than the first wave (April 2020-December 2020, 4 deaths).
